entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Have you finally come to your senses?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Ngh...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: How foolishly you averted your eyes from the truth...
entries.uk: Як нерозумно ти відвертав очі[n]від правди...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: A deplorable imitation indeed...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Best you part from that aspect of yourself!
entries.uk: Тож розпрощайся з цією частиною себе!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A-Aaaagh!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: Let us now forge a contract...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: I am thou, thou art I...
entries.uk: Я — це ти, а ти — це я...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: The world is filled with both beauty and vice...
entries.uk: Світ сповнений і краси, і пороку...

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: It is time you teach people which is which!
entries.uk: Час тобі навчити людей розрізняти їх!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Come, Goemon!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: A breathtaking sight...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Imitations they may be, but together, they make a fine spectacle...
entries.uk: Хай це й підробки, але разом вони[n]творять чудове видовище...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Though the flowers of evil blossom, be it known...[n]Abominations are fated to perish!
entries.uk: Хай квіти зла й буяють, та знайте...[n]Мерзоті судилося згинути!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whoa, this is impressive!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Hmph... Who do you think you are!?
entries.uk: Гм... Та за кого ти себе маєш?!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: The price for your insolence will be death!

entries.speaker: Shadow Madarame
entries.en: Where are my guards!? Kill them all!
entries.uk: Де моя варта?! Убити їх усіх!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The children who adored you as "father"...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The prospects of your pupils...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How many did you trample upon?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: How many dreams did you exchange for riches!?
entries.uk: Скільки мрій ти проміняв на багатство?!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: No matter what it takes... I will bring you to justice!
entries.uk: Хай чого це коштуватиме...[n]я притягну тебе до відповіді!

entries.en: You got this?
You better not run away.
Let's see what you're made of.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I am ready!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Same goes to you!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Very well! Bring it on!
